description: The Memory Light Base™ Small in Essentials Wood is the entry-tier illumination stand for 3D Memory Crystals from Beyond Memories®. A compact wooden base with a soft warm-white LED that fires through a centered dispersor under the crystal, lifting the engraving out of shadow and into clean tabletop view. Sized for the Small and Medium crystals across every shape - rectangle, heart, cube, hexagon, arc - and finished in either glossy black lacquer or polished rosewood to match your decor.  The light base does what ambient daylight cannot: it illuminates the engraving from below, making the 3D image visible in dim rooms, after dark, and during the times of day when most photos actually sit on a desk or nightstand. The dispersor lens sits centered on the top face under the crystal, so the light glows up through the K9 glass without spilling sideways. USB-powered - runs from any standard USB charger, laptop, or wall adapter.   Two finishes: glossy lacquered black or polished rosewood - available in both Sized for Small and Medium 3D Memory Crystals across every shape Warm white LED (cool white optional on larger bases) - soft, even illumination Centered top-face dispersor lens - lights the engraving from below, no sideways spill USB-A power cable included - runs from any standard USB charger or laptop port Solid wood construction - weighted base, anti-slip felt feet Clean side faces, no visible buttons or hardware Easy on/off via the included inline switch Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the light base works The dispersor is a small recessed lens centered on the top face of the base, directly under where the crystal sits. Inside the wooden housing, a warm-white LED shines upward through the dispersor, which spreads the light evenly into the bottom of the crystal. The K9 optical crystal then carries that light through its volume, illuminating the engraved 3D image from below. The result is a soft glow that makes the engraving visible without making the base itself look like a lit object - you see the photo, not the light source.  What crystals fit this size The Small light base is designed for Small and Medium crystals across every Beyond Memories shape: the rectangle portrait, the heart, the cube, and the hexagon. The base footprint is sized so the crystal sits centered over the dispersor lens with no edge overhang. For Large, XL, or Max crystals, choose the Medium or Large base - the dispersor lens is sized to match. Mini crystals work on the Small base but the lens may be partially visible around the base of the crystal.  What's in the box Your Memory Light Base ships in a premium gift-ready box - the same navy presentation box used for Beyond Memories crystals, with the wordmark in gold and custom-cut foam protecting the base in transit. The box contains the wooden light base in your chosen finish, a USB-A power cable with an inline on/off switch, and a printed quick-start card. When ordered alongside a crystal, the light base and the crystal ship together in the same box.  Light base care The wooden housing has a protective lacquer (black) or natural oil (rosewood) finish - an occasional wipe with a soft dry cloth keeps it clean. Avoid wet cleaning. Keep the dispersor lens dust-free by lifting the crystal off and wiping the lens with a microfiber. Indoor use only; do not leave in direct sunlight for prolonged periods.  Production and shipping Light bases ship from stock in 1-2 business days when ordered alone. When ordered alongside a custom-engraved crystal, the bundle ships in 1-2 business days (crystal production window). U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout.  Frequently asked questions Will this light base fit my crystal? Small fits Small and Medium crystals across every shape. Large, XL, and Max crystals need the Medium or Large light base. Mini crystals fit the Small base but the dispersor lens may show slightly around the crystal edge.  What color is the LED? Warm white - a soft, golden-toned light that suits photographic engravings without color-casting the image. The Premium light bases offer cool white.  Battery or plug-in? Plug-in via USB. The included USB-A cable runs from any standard USB charger, laptop port, power bank, or wall adapter. No batteries to replace.  Can I leave it on all the time? Yes. The LED is low-power and rated for continuous use. Many customers leave it on as a soft nightlight.  Why is the dispersor on top? The 3D engraving is most visible when light enters the crystal from directly below. Top-face placement keeps the light path short and even and prevents the sideways glow of edge-lit bases. The dispersor is invisible when the crystal sits on top - you see the illuminated photo, not the light source.  Essentials Wood vs Premium Wood? Essentials uses warm white LED and the standard top-face dispersor. Premium adds cool white as a second LED option, a more refined wood finish, and (on some sizes) color-changing modes. See the Premium Light Base for the upgrade. Crisp white curtains with clean lines and metallic hardware suit contemporary patios or rooftop terraces.. d. Romantic Garden. Your image is sculpted into a three-dimensional model, engraved inside a block of K9 optical crystal with a 4K laser, and hand-polished before it ships. The cube is the only shape in the Beyond Memories® collection where the engraved photo reads correctly from four sides - a 360° keepsake that sits beautifully on a desk, a shelf, or a nightstand. Every cube starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it for clarity, then converts it into a precise 3D model. The 4K laser focuses pulses at exact depths inside the K9 glass, leaving microscopic refractive points that form your image with lifelike volume. The cube is a true 360° keepsake - the same photo reads clearly from four sides. Pair it with the Memory Light Base for an illuminated tabletop display. What photo works best The cube favors a single subject or a tightly framed couple - wedding portraits, family close-ups, anniversary photos, beloved pets. A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) gives the sharpest engraving. Plain backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. If you have a phone photo taken in good natural light, that almost always works. Wide group shots, action photos, or images where the subject is very small in the frame are better suited to the rectangle portrait crystal or the heart-shaped crystal. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if your image needs adjustment. What's in the box Your cube ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add the Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe, but a few habits keep it looking its best. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which can warm the glass and affect a paired light base. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. If the surface needs deeper cleaning, a drop of dish soap in warm water and a thorough dry will not damage the engraving. What's the difference between Standard and 4K HD engraving? Standard produces a sharp 3D image suitable for most photos. The 4K HD upgrade adds about 50% more dots - finer detail, smoother gradients, most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. Both use the same K9 optical crystal. Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes. Add your text in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge. What cube sizes are available? Small, Medium, and Large. description: The 2D Memory Crystal™ Keychain - Octagon from Beyond Memories® turns one favorite photo into a daily-carry octagonal keepsake. Your photo is laser-engraved into a solid block of optical-grade crystal in true high-definition detail. The work is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms.      Optical-grade crystal - clear, scratch-resistant, hand-polished perimeter    Octagon geometry - eight-sided pendant, chiseled multi-faceted edges around the perimeter    2D subsurface laser engraving - photo permanently engraved inside the pendant    Polished chrome cylindrical bail - distinctive tall connector with horizontal accent bands    Polished chrome split-ring keyring loop - ~0.7" diameter, fits any keychain    Premium gift-ready box - satin-lined, ready to gift    Daily-carry durable - designed for years of pocket, bag, and keyring wear    Free photo enhancement - we clean up the photo before engraving    U.S. studio + U.S. support - Las Vegas based   Perfect for everyday carry, birthday gifts, and the small intentional moments  The keychain is the gift that comes with the person everywhere they go. For a partner, the keychain quietly says I'm with you every day - even when you're not in the room. For a parent (especially a new dad who just got his first set of "new responsibilities" keys), engraving the kids' faces inside the keychain is the gesture that lands. For best friends marking a milestone - a college graduation, a move to a new city, the end of a chapter - the keychain becomes the small token that travels with them. For the recipient who has everything and doesn't need anything, the keychain is the thing they didn't know they wanted: a daily-use object with the people they love inside it. The octagon geometry signals this isn't generic in a way the standard rectangle doesn't.  How the personalization works  Upload one favorite photo through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, sharpens facial detail, and prepares the image for engraving. We then engrave the image into the octagonal optical-crystal pendant using a precision laser. The pendant attaches to the polished chrome bail and split-ring loop at our Las Vegas studio. Standard production takes 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout.  What photo works best for the keychain  Because the keychain pendant is small (~1.1" wide), the photo needs to read clearly at that scale. Single-subject portraits are the sweet spot - one person, one pet, or one couple with both faces close. The keychain handles 2-subject portraits well; 3+ subjects start to get cramped. The octagon shape works especially well with portraits oriented as headshots rather than full-body shots. Choose a well-lit, clear photo where the eyes are visible and the face takes up most of the frame. Avoid full-body shots, group photos, very dark photos, and heavy filters. A crawl space ventilation fan is essential because perennially confined crawl spaces lack proper outside air circulation, leading to the accumulation of moist air. Moreover, airborne spores from mold can infiltrate living spaces through floors, cracks, and crawl space HVAC systems, resulting in indoor air pollution that poses health risks to you and your family. Therefore, a crawl space ventilation fan is crucial for maintaining proper air circulation and preventing moisture-related issues and indoor air pollution. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Tabletop Square from Beyond Memories® is the modern centerpiece for any room: a perfect square block of optical crystal with razor-sharp 90-degree edges, engraved with your favorite photo in true three-dimensional detail. The square shape gives any portrait or family photo a contemporary, gallery-clean presentation that works in modern living rooms, on minimalist consoles, in office spaces, and on bookshelves where you want the image - not the frame - to be the focus. For milestone birthdays (40, 50, 60, 70), the square anchors the moment without any seasonal coding - it works year-round, in any room, for any photograph that deserves to be sculpted in light.  How the personalization works  Pick the size that fits your space - Small (about 2.5 inches) for a bookshelf or office desk, Medium for a console or sideboard, Large for a mantel anchor, XL or 2XL for a centerpiece moment. Portraits, family group photos, couples, scenic shots with people in them, even pet photos all work beautifully. The square geometry is forgiving of slightly different photo aspect ratios - we will crop intelligently. For maximum impact, choose a photo where the subjects (faces) take up roughly the central two-thirds of the frame. Group shots with up to 6 people engrave well in the Medium and Large sizes. Avoid photos with very busy backgrounds (we will remove them anyway), heavy filters, or extreme distortion. Send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend the strongest candidate.  What's in the box  Every Tabletop Square ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. Dust monthly with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Avoid extreme heat or chemical contact. The engraving lives inside the glass, so the portrait will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today. The square shape handles 2-6 people very well, especially in Medium and Large sizes. For larger groups (8+), the Rectangle or XL Square engrave better.  Will the engraving look as sharp on the Small as on the Large? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraves at the same resolution regardless of crystal size; the difference is simply the physical scale of the engraved image.  Do I need the Memory Light Base? The crystal looks beautiful on its own and reads clearly in normal room light. The Light Base (sold separately) adds dramatic illumination in eight LED colors and is recommended if the crystal will live in a low-light area or you want the engraving to glow at night.  Is this a good corporate or office gift? Yes. Why should we consider installing a crawl space ventilation fan? The perennially enclosed nature of crawl spaces leads to a lack of external air circulation, resulting in the accumulation of moisture within the space. Additionally, damp wood attracts pests such as reptiles, which further exacerbates the damage. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Tabletop Square from Beyond Memories® is the modern centerpiece for any room: a perfect square block of optical crystal with razor-sharp 90-degree edges, engraved with your favorite photo in true three-dimensional detail. The square shape gives any portrait or family photo a contemporary, gallery-clean presentation that works in modern living rooms, on minimalist consoles, in office spaces, and on bookshelves where you want the image - not the frame - to be the focus. The portrait lives inside the glass and will never fade, peel, or yellow. Every step is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms.      K9 optical crystal - lead-free, perfectly clear, hand-polished to optical-grade finish    True 3D subsurface engraving - image sculpted in three dimensions inside the crystal    4K HD upgrade - available on all sizes for the highest level of facial and scene detail    Five sizes - Small, Medium, Large, XL, and 2XL to anchor any room    Razor-sharp 90-degree edges - precision-cut square geometry for a contemporary aesthetic    Free photo enhancement - our in-house artists clean up your photo before engraving (no extra cost)    Memory Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving with eight LED colors    Premium gift-ready box - satin-lined presentation box included    U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - Las Vegas based, real humans on the phone   Perfect for the everyday, the milestone, and the in-between  The square shape is the modern crystal - it fits anywhere clean lines matter. New parents engrave their first family portrait. Couples mark anniversaries, wedding days, and engagement-day photos. Families build a console gallery of multi-generational portraits in matching sizes. Professionals use the square for office and corporate-gift contexts where the rectangular crystal would feel too tall and the heart too informal. For milestone birthdays (40, 50, 60, 70), the square anchors the moment without any seasonal coding - it works year-round, in any room, for any photograph that deserves to be sculpted in light.  How the personalization works  Pick the size that fits your space - Small (about 2.5 inches) for a bookshelf or office desk, Medium for a console or sideboard, Large for a mantel anchor, XL or 2XL for a centerpiece moment. Upload your favorite photo through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then sculpt the photo in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the crystal. Standard production is 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout.  What photo works best in the square shape  The square is the most versatile shape in our lineup. Portraits, family group photos, couples, scenic shots with people in them, even pet photos all work beautifully. The square geometry is forgiving of slightly different photo aspect ratios - we will crop intelligently. For maximum impact, choose a photo where the subjects (faces) take up roughly the central two-thirds of the frame. Group shots with up to 6 people engrave well in the Medium and Large sizes. Avoid photos with very busy backgrounds (we will remove them anyway), heavy filters, or extreme distortion. Send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend the strongest candidate.  What's in the box  Every Tabletop Square ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The crystal nestles in soft satin against dark linen lining - designed for the moment someone opens the box at a birthday, wedding, or holiday and sees the photo materialize inside the glass.  Crystal care  K9 optical crystal is built to outlive trends. Display the crystal in any room away from direct sunlight (which can warm the optics over decades). Dust monthly with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Avoid extreme heat or chemical contact. The engraving lives inside the glass, so the portrait will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today.  Production and shipping  Standard production takes 1-2 business days. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. We ship from our Las Vegas studio with full tracking via UPS/FedEx. Domestic U.S. shipping is included on most orders. International shipping calculated at checkout to most countries. Each size is shown with concrete inch dimensions on the variant picker.  Can I engrave a group photo in the Square? Yes. The square shape handles 2-6 people very well, especially in Medium and Large sizes. For larger groups (8+), the Rectangle or XL Square engrave better.  Will the engraving look as sharp on the Small as on the Large? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraves at the same resolution regardless of crystal size; the difference is simply the physical scale of the engraved image.  Do I need the Memory Light Base? The crystal looks beautiful on its own and reads clearly in normal room light. The Light Base (sold separately) adds dramatic illumination in eight LED colors and is recommended if the crystal will live in a low-light area or you want the engraving to glow at night.  Is this a good corporate or office gift? Yes. The square geometry reads as professional and contemporary, which makes the Square the most-ordered crystal for retirement gifts, corporate awards, real-estate closings, and executive milestone moments.  What if I'm not happy with the engraving? We have a 30-day satisfaction promise. If the engraving doesn't capture the moment the way you imagined, we will rework it at no cost or refund the order. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Tabletop Square from Beyond Memories® is the modern centerpiece for any room: a perfect square block of optical crystal with razor-sharp 90-degree edges, engraved with your favorite photo in true three-dimensional detail. The square shape gives any portrait or family photo a contemporary, gallery-clean presentation that works in modern living rooms, on minimalist consoles, in office spaces, and on bookshelves where you want the image - not the frame - to be the focus. New parents engrave their first family portrait. Couples mark anniversaries, wedding days, and engagement-day photos. Families build a console gallery of multi-generational portraits in matching sizes. Professionals use the square for office and corporate-gift contexts where the rectangular crystal would feel too tall and the heart too informal. For milestone birthdays (40, 50, 60, 70), the square anchors the moment without any seasonal coding - it works year-round, in any room, for any photograph that deserves to be sculpted in light.  How the personalization works  Pick the size that fits your space - Small (about 2.5 inches) for a bookshelf or office desk, Medium for a console or sideboard, Large for a mantel anchor, XL or 2XL for a centerpiece moment. Upload your favorite photo through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then sculpt the photo in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the crystal. Standard production is 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout.  What photo works best in the square shape  The square is the most versatile shape in our lineup. Portraits, family group photos, couples, scenic shots with people in them, even pet photos all work beautifully. The square geometry is forgiving of slightly different photo aspect ratios - we will crop intelligently. For maximum impact, choose a photo where the subjects (faces) take up roughly the central two-thirds of the frame. Group shots with up to 6 people engrave well in the Medium and Large sizes. Avoid photos with very busy backgrounds (we will remove them anyway), heavy filters, or extreme distortion. Send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend the strongest candidate.  What's in the box  Every Tabletop Square ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The crystal nestles in soft satin against dark linen lining - designed for the moment someone opens the box at a birthday, wedding, or holiday and sees the photo materialize inside the glass.  Crystal care  K9 optical crystal is built to outlive trends. Display the crystal in any room away from direct sunlight (which can warm the optics over decades). Dust monthly with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Avoid extreme heat or chemical contact. The engraving lives inside the glass, so the portrait will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today.  Production and shipping  Standard production takes 1-2 business days. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. We ship from our Las Vegas studio with full tracking via UPS/FedEx. Domestic U.S. shipping is included on most orders. International shipping calculated at checkout to most countries. Each size is shown with concrete inch dimensions on the variant picker.  Can I engrave a group photo in the Square? Yes. The square shape handles 2-6 people very well, especially in Medium and Large sizes. For larger groups (8+), the Rectangle or XL Square engrave better.  Will the engraving look as sharp on the Small as on the Large? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraves at the same resolution regardless of crystal size; the difference is simply the physical scale of the engraved image.  Do I need the Memory Light Base? The crystal looks beautiful on its own and reads clearly in normal room light. The Light Base (sold separately) adds dramatic illumination in eight LED colors and is recommended if the crystal will live in a low-light area or you want the engraving to glow at night.  Is this a good corporate or office gift? Yes. The square geometry reads as professional and contemporary, which makes the Square the most-ordered crystal for retirement gifts, corporate awards, real-estate closings, and executive milestone moments. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Tabletop Square from Beyond Memories® is the modern centerpiece for any room: a perfect square block of optical crystal with razor-sharp 90-degree edges, engraved with your favorite photo in true three-dimensional detail. The square shape gives any portrait or family photo a contemporary, gallery-clean presentation that works in modern living rooms, on minimalist consoles, in office spaces, and on bookshelves where you want the image - not the frame - to be the focus.  Your photo is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and laser-engraved deep inside the K9 optical crystal using a precision 4K subsurface laser. The portrait lives inside the glass and will never fade, peel, or yellow. Every step is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms.      K9 optical crystal - lead-free, perfectly clear, hand-polished to optical-grade finish    True 3D subsurface engraving - image sculpted in three dimensions inside the crystal    4K HD upgrade - available on all sizes for the highest level of facial and scene detail    Five sizes - Small, Medium, Large, XL, and 2XL to anchor any room    Razor-sharp 90-degree edges - precision-cut square geometry for a contemporary aesthetic    Free photo enhancement - our in-house artists clean up your photo before engraving (no extra cost)    Memory Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving with eight LED colors    Premium gift-ready box - satin-lined presentation box included    U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - Las Vegas based, real humans on the phone   Perfect for the everyday, the milestone, and the in-between  The square shape is the modern crystal - it fits anywhere clean lines matter. New parents engrave their first family portrait. Couples mark anniversaries, wedding days, and engagement-day photos. Families build a console gallery of multi-generational portraits in matching sizes. Professionals use the square for office and corporate-gift contexts where the rectangular crystal would feel too tall and the heart too informal. For milestone birthdays (40, 50, 60, 70), the square anchors the moment without any seasonal coding - it works year-round, in any room, for any photograph that deserves to be sculpted in light.  How the personalization works  Pick the size that fits your space - Small (about 2.5 inches) for a bookshelf or office desk, Medium for a console or sideboard, Large for a mantel anchor, XL or 2XL for a centerpiece moment. Upload your favorite photo through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then sculpt the photo in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the crystal. Standard production is 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout.  What photo works best in the square shape  The square is the most versatile shape in our lineup. Portraits, family group photos, couples, scenic shots with people in them, even pet photos all work beautifully. The square geometry is forgiving of slightly different photo aspect ratios - we will crop intelligently. For maximum impact, choose a photo where the subjects (faces) take up roughly the central two-thirds of the frame. Group shots with up to 6 people engrave well in the Medium and Large sizes. Avoid photos with very busy backgrounds (we will remove them anyway), heavy filters, or extreme distortion. Send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend the strongest candidate.  What's in the box  Every Tabletop Square ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The crystal nestles in soft satin against dark linen lining - designed for the moment someone opens the box at a birthday, wedding, or holiday and sees the photo materialize inside the glass.  Crystal care  K9 optical crystal is built to outlive trends. Display the crystal in any room away from direct sunlight (which can warm the optics over decades). Dust monthly with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Avoid extreme heat or chemical contact. The engraving lives inside the glass, so the portrait will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today.  Production and shipping  Standard production takes 1-2 business days. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. We ship from our Las Vegas studio with full tracking via UPS/FedEx. Domestic U.S. shipping is included on most orders. International shipping calculated at checkout to most countries. Holiday cutoff dates are posted on the product page and updated weekly for guaranteed delivery.  Frequently asked questions  What sizes do you offer for the Square? Small, Medium, Large, XL, and 2XL. Each size is shown with concrete inch dimensions on the variant picker.  Can I engrave a group photo in the Square? Yes. The square shape handles 2-6 people very well, especially in Medium and Large sizes. For larger groups (8+), the Rectangle or XL Square engrave better.  Will the engraving look as sharp on the Small as on the Large? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraves at the same resolution regardless of crystal size; the difference is simply the physical scale of the engraved image.  Do I need the Memory Light Base? The crystal looks beautiful on its own and reads clearly in normal room light. The Light Base (sold separately) adds dramatic illumination in eight LED colors and is recommended if the crystal will live in a low-light area or you want the engraving to glow at night.  Is this a good corporate or office gift? Yes. The square geometry reads as professional and contemporary, which makes the Square the most-ordered crystal for retirement gifts, corporate awards, real-estate closings, and executive milestone moments.  What if I'm not happy with the engraving? We have a 30-day satisfaction promise. If the engraving doesn't capture the moment the way you imagined, we will rework it at no cost or refund the order. Engrave a photo from her wedding day for a 25th, 40th, or 50th anniversary. Use a Grandma-and-grandkids photo for her 70th or 80th birthday. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to four people; for larger family groups, the classic Rectangle portrait in a larger size has more room.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload Mom's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Mom's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Mom, Mom with one or two grandkids, Mom and Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Mom's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. A folded handwritten card slot lets you add a personal note inside the box. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet. Small is best for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or bookshelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or display cabinet. If she'll display it close to where she sits, Small is plenty.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms (evenings, dimmer-lit corners). Worth it if Mom will display it somewhere without strong daylight.  Can I add a name, date, or message? Yes - add your text in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is still excellent and most customers can't tell the difference at arm's length.  How long does it last? Indefinitely. The engraving is permanent inside the K9 crystal - it does not fade, peel, or scratch off. See our guide on how long 3D crystals last. After you upload Mom's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Mom's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Mom, Mom with one or two grandkids, Mom and Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Mom's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. If she'll display it close to where she sits, Small is plenty.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms (evenings, dimmer-lit corners). Worth it if Mom will display it somewhere without strong daylight.  Can I add a name, date, or message? Yes - add your text in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners. Standard is still excellent and most customers can't tell the difference at arm's length.  How long does it last? Indefinitely. The engraving is permanent inside the K9 crystal - it does not fade, peel, or scratch off. See our guide on how long 3D crystals last. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Memorial Edition is a lasting tribute keepsake from Beyond Memories® - a portrait of someone you've lost, engraved inside K9 optical crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. The rectangle is the most-ordered shape for memorial keepsakes because it frames a face the way a traditional portrait does: vertical, dignified, the photo at its centre. The engraving remains as sharp on the 20th anniversary as on the day it ships.  Every memorial crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances each photo for laser clarity - a process that often makes older, lower-resolution photos engrave better than the original looks on paper. A 4K laser then fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building the portrait one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - older photos and lower-resolution images often workable Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated tribute display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The memorial portrait is engraved inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it - older photos, scans of prints, and lower-resolution phone shots are common with memorial orders, and our retouchers often enhance them significantly before engraving. Our artists then convert the prepared image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming the portrait with lifelike volume. Pair with the Memory Light Base for a soft, illuminated tribute display.  What photo works best A clear portrait in good natural light produces the sharpest engraving, but for memorial orders the choice is often emotional rather than technical. We work with what you have. Older film photographs scanned at any reasonable resolution, prints photographed with a phone, and group photos cropped to a single face all work. Vertical orientation suits the rectangle shape best. If you only have one photo and it isn't perfect, send it - our team will tell you what's possible before production starts.  What's in the box Your memorial crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam. With a Memory Light Base added, both ship in the same box with the USB-C power cable. The navy presentation box is appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child without rewrapping.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe, designed to last generations. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - a mantel, a bedside table, a memorial corner, or a shelf with the things that matter. Yes. We've retouched film scans from the 1950s, school portraits from the 1980s, and Polaroids photographed with a phone. Send what you've got - we'll email you before production if it can't be made workable.  Can I include dates - born and passed? Yes. Add the name, dates, or short message in Special Instructions at checkout - no extra charge. Common format: name above the photo, dates below.  What size is right? Small or Medium for personal display. Large, XL, or Max for a mantel or shared family display. Multi-face engravings are sharpest in Medium and up.  Is the crystal appropriate as a gift? Yes - memorial 3D crystals are one of our largest gift categories. The premium navy gift box makes it appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer facial detail, smoother gradients, sharper eyes - most noticeable up close or with a light base. For a keepsake meant to last generations, 4K HD is worth it.  Should I add a light base? Most memorial customers do. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Memorial-Standard / Medium
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Memorial Edition is a lasting tribute keepsake from Beyond Memories® - a portrait of someone you've lost, engraved inside K9 optical crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. The rectangle is the most-ordered shape for memorial keepsakes because it frames a face the way a traditional portrait does: vertical, dignified, the photo at its centre. The engraving remains as sharp on the 20th anniversary as on the day it ships.  Every memorial crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances each photo for laser clarity - a process that often makes older, lower-resolution photos engrave better than the original looks on paper. A 4K laser then fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building the portrait one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - older photos and lower-resolution images often workable Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated tribute display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The memorial portrait is engraved inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it - older photos, scans of prints, and lower-resolution phone shots are common with memorial orders, and our retouchers often enhance them significantly before engraving. Our artists then convert the prepared image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming the portrait with lifelike volume. Pair with the Memory Light Base for a soft, illuminated tribute display.  What photo works best A clear portrait in good natural light produces the sharpest engraving, but for memorial orders the choice is often emotional rather than technical. We work with what you have. Older film photographs scanned at any reasonable resolution, prints photographed with a phone, and group photos cropped to a single face all work. Vertical orientation suits the rectangle shape best. If you only have one photo and it isn't perfect, send it - our team will tell you what's possible before production starts.  What's in the box Your memorial crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam. With a Memory Light Base added, both ship in the same box with the USB-C power cable. The navy presentation box is appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child without rewrapping.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe, designed to last generations. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - a mantel, a bedside table, a memorial corner, or a shelf with the things that matter.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination. Add a service date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production. We treat memorial timelines with priority.  Frequently asked questions Can you work with an old photograph? Yes. We've retouched film scans from the 1950s, school portraits from the 1980s, and Polaroids photographed with a phone. Send what you've got - we'll email you before production if it can't be made workable.  Can I include dates - born and passed? Yes. Add the name, dates, or short message in Special Instructions at checkout - no extra charge. Common format: name above the photo, dates below.  What size is right? Small or Medium for personal display. Large, XL, or Max for a mantel or shared family display. Multi-face engravings are sharpest in Medium and up.  Is the crystal appropriate as a gift? Yes - memorial 3D crystals are one of our largest gift categories. The premium navy gift box makes it appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer facial detail, smoother gradients, sharper eyes - most noticeable up close or with a light base. For a keepsake meant to last generations, 4K HD is worth it.  Should I add a light base? Most memorial customers do. The Memory Light Base adds soft uplight that makes the engraving visible in low light - on a nightstand, on a mantel after dark. See our guide on whether you need a light base. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Memorial Edition is a lasting tribute keepsake from Beyond Memories® - a portrait of someone you've lost, engraved inside K9 optical crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. The rectangle is the most-ordered shape for memorial keepsakes because it frames a face the way a traditional portrait does: vertical, dignified, the photo at its centre. The engraving remains as sharp on the 20th anniversary as on the day it ships.  Every memorial crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances each photo for laser clarity - a process that often makes older, lower-resolution photos engrave better than the original looks on paper. A 4K laser then fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building the portrait one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - older photos and lower-resolution images often workable Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated tribute display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The memorial portrait is engraved inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it - older photos, scans of prints, and lower-resolution phone shots are common with memorial orders, and our retouchers often enhance them significantly before engraving. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Memorial-4K HD / Small
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Memorial Edition is a lasting tribute keepsake from Beyond Memories® - a portrait of someone you've lost, engraved inside K9 optical crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. The rectangle is the most-ordered shape for memorial keepsakes because it frames a face the way a traditional portrait does: vertical, dignified, the photo at its centre. The engraving remains as sharp on the 20th anniversary as on the day it ships.  Every memorial crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances each photo for laser clarity - a process that often makes older, lower-resolution photos engrave better than the original looks on paper. A 4K laser then fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building the portrait one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - older photos and lower-resolution images often workable Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated tribute display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The memorial portrait is engraved inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it - older photos, scans of prints, and lower-resolution phone shots are common with memorial orders, and our retouchers often enhance them significantly before engraving. Our artists then convert the prepared image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming the portrait with lifelike volume. Pair with the Memory Light Base for a soft, illuminated tribute display.  What photo works best A clear portrait in good natural light produces the sharpest engraving, but for memorial orders the choice is often emotional rather than technical. We work with what you have. Older film photographs scanned at any reasonable resolution, prints photographed with a phone, and group photos cropped to a single face all work. Vertical orientation suits the rectangle shape best. If you only have one photo and it isn't perfect, send it - our team will tell you what's possible before production starts.  What's in the box Your memorial crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam. With a Memory Light Base added, both ship in the same box with the USB-C power cable. The navy presentation box is appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child without rewrapping.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe, designed to last generations. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - a mantel, a bedside table, a memorial corner, or a shelf with the things that matter.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination. Add a service date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production. We treat memorial timelines with priority.  Frequently asked questions Can you work with an old photograph? Yes. We've retouched film scans from the 1950s, school portraits from the 1980s, and Polaroids photographed with a phone. Send what you've got - we'll email you before production if it can't be made workable.  Can I include dates - born and passed? Yes. Add the name, dates, or short message in Special Instructions at checkout - no extra charge. Common format: name above the photo, dates below.  What size is right? Small or Medium for personal display. Large, XL, or Max for a mantel or shared family display. Multi-face engravings are sharpest in Medium and up.  Is the crystal appropriate as a gift? Yes - memorial 3D crystals are one of our largest gift categories. The premium navy gift box makes it appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer facial detail, smoother gradients, sharper eyes - most noticeable up close or with a light base. For a keepsake meant to last generations, 4K HD is worth it.  Should I add a light base? Most memorial customers do. The Memory Light Base adds soft uplight that makes the engraving visible in low light - on a nightstand, on a mantel after dark. See our guide on whether you need a light base. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Memorial Edition is a lasting tribute keepsake from Beyond Memories® - a portrait of someone you've lost, engraved inside K9 optical crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. The rectangle is the most-ordered shape for memorial keepsakes because it frames a face the way a traditional portrait does: vertical, dignified, the photo at its centre. The engraving remains as sharp on the 20th anniversary as on the day it ships.  Every memorial crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances each photo for laser clarity - a process that often makes older, lower-resolution photos engrave better than the original looks on paper. A 4K laser then fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building the portrait one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - older photos and lower-resolution images often workable Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated tribute display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The memorial portrait is engraved inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it - older photos, scans of prints, and lower-resolution phone shots are common with memorial orders, and our retouchers often enhance them significantly before engraving. Our artists then convert the prepared image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming the portrait with lifelike volume. Pair with the Memory Light Base for a soft, illuminated tribute display.  What photo works best A clear portrait in good natural light produces the sharpest engraving, but for memorial orders the choice is often emotional rather than technical. We work with what you have. Older film photographs scanned at any reasonable resolution, prints photographed with a phone, and group photos cropped to a single face all work. Vertical orientation suits the rectangle shape best. If you only have one photo and it isn't perfect, send it - our team will tell you what's possible before production starts.  What's in the box Your memorial crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam. With a Memory Light Base added, both ship in the same box with the USB-C power cable. The navy presentation box is appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child without rewrapping.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe, designed to last generations. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - a mantel, a bedside table, a memorial corner, or a shelf with the things that matter.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination. Add a service date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production. We treat memorial timelines with priority.  Frequently asked questions Can you work with an old photograph? Yes. We've retouched film scans from the 1950s, school portraits from the 1980s, and Polaroids photographed with a phone. Send what you've got - we'll email you before production if it can't be made workable.  Can I include dates - born and passed? Yes. Add the name, dates, or short message in Special Instructions at checkout - no extra charge. Common format: name above the photo, dates below.  What size is right? Small or Medium for personal display. Large, XL, or Max for a mantel or shared family display. Multi-face engravings are sharpest in Medium and up.  Is the crystal appropriate as a gift? Yes - memorial 3D crystals are one of our largest gift categories. The premium navy gift box makes it appropriate for direct gifting to a grieving spouse, parent, or child.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer facial detail, smoother gradients, sharper eyes - most noticeable up close or with a light base. For a keepsake meant to last generations, 4K HD is worth it.  Should I add a light base? Most memorial customers do. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Dad is a Father's Day, birthday, retirement, or just-because keepsake that turns your favorite photo of Dad into a piece of K9 optical crystal. A gift that suits Dad's desk, his workshop bench, or the mantel above his armchair.  Every Rectangle for Dad starts with the photo you upload at checkout. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building Dad's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the natural format for vertical family photos 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background before engraving Available in five sizes from Small to Max - pick the size that suits his display surface Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives the finest gradient, most noticeable up close Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot   Perfect for the milestones that matter to Dad The Rectangle for Dad is the Beyond Memories crystal most-ordered for Father's Day, but it works for every milestone in Dad's calendar. Engrave a fishing-trip photo for his retirement. Use a photo with the grandkids for his 60th, 70th, or 80th birthday. Pull a candid from the day he taught you to drive, or you taught him to use a smartphone. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to four people; for larger family groups, choose the XL or Max size. For more recipient-specific framing, also see the Heart for Dad variant.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload Dad's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Dad's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Dad, Dad with one or two of the grandkids, Mom-and-Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Dad's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. Add a handwritten card or paternal note inside the gift box at no extra charge. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts.  Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick? Small is best for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or bookshelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or den display. For a workshop or garage, Small or Medium fits naturally on the bench.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms. Worth it if Dad will display it somewhere without strong daylight.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Common additions: "Dad" or "Grandpa" below the portrait, the date in a corner.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos.  Is the Rectangle for Dad a good retirement gift? Yes - it's a common retirement keepsake in our orders. Engrave a photo from the role he's retiring from, or a family portrait, and add the years of service in Special Instructions. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building Dad's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to four people; for larger family groups, choose the XL or Max size. For more recipient-specific framing, also see the Heart for Dad variant.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload Dad's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Dad's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Dad, Dad with one or two of the grandkids, Mom-and-Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Dad's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts. Small is best for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or bookshelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or den display. For a workshop or garage, Small or Medium fits naturally on the bench.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms. Worth it if Dad will display it somewhere without strong daylight.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Common additions: "Dad" or "Grandpa" below the portrait, the date in a corner.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Dad is a Father's Day, birthday, retirement, or just-because keepsake that turns your favorite photo of Dad into a piece of K9 optical crystal. The rectangle is the classic Beyond Memories® portrait shape - your photo sculpted in three dimensions and laser-engraved inside a block of crystal so it can be seen from every angle. Pair it with a Memory Light Base™ for soft illumination from below and the engraving glows even in dim evening light. A gift that suits Dad's desk, his workshop bench, or the mantel above his armchair.  Every Rectangle for Dad starts with the photo you upload at checkout. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building Dad's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the natural format for vertical family photos 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background before engraving Available in five sizes from Small to Max - pick the size that suits his display surface Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives the finest gradient, most noticeable up close Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot   Perfect for the milestones that matter to Dad The Rectangle for Dad is the Beyond Memories crystal most-ordered for Father's Day, but it works for every milestone in Dad's calendar. Engrave a fishing-trip photo for his retirement. Use a photo with the grandkids for his 60th, 70th, or 80th birthday. Pull a candid from the day he taught you to drive, or you taught him to use a smartphone. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to four people; for larger family groups, choose the XL or Max size. For more recipient-specific framing, also see the Heart for Dad variant.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload Dad's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Dad's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Dad, Dad with one or two of the grandkids, Mom-and-Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Dad's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. Add a handwritten card or paternal note inside the gift box at no extra charge. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts.  Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick? Small is best for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or bookshelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or den display. For a workshop or garage, Small or Medium fits naturally on the bench.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms. Worth it if Dad will display it somewhere without strong daylight.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Common additions: "Dad" or "Grandpa" below the portrait, the date in a corner.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos. Engrave a photo from the role he's retiring from, or a family portrait, and add the years of service in Special Instructions. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Pet Lovers-Standard / Small
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone.  Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display.  What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works.  What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production.  Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal.  Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail.  Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge.  Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it.  What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet.
