description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone.  Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display.  What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works.  What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production.  Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal.  Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail.  Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge.  Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it.  What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Pet Lovers-Standard / Mini
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone.  Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display.  What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works.  What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production.  Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal.  Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail.  Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge.  Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it.  What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone.  Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display.  What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works.  What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production.  Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal.  Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail.  Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge.  Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it.  What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Pet Lovers-4K HD / Mini
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone.  Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included   How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display.  What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works.  What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production.  Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal.  Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail.  Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge.  Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it.  What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building the image one layer at a time from the inside out. For a square format, see the Square Anniversary variant; for the heart silhouette, see the Wedding Heart.  How the personalization works The engraving lives inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload your wedding photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, restoring older photos where needed (color fading, faded contrast, light scratches). We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's vertical proportions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass. You can layer the portrait with text - names, wedding date, anniversary year, vows excerpt - via Special Instructions at checkout. Our design team mocks up the layout before production starts.  What photo works best The rectangle favors vertical portrait framings - the classic wedding-day portrait, a couple-on-the-day-of candid, or a fresh anniversary portrait. Clear, well-lit photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. For golden and diamond anniversaries we routinely engrave wedding photos from the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s - our team handles light restoration at no extra charge. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts.  Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick for our anniversary? Small for a bedside or vanity display; Medium is the most-ordered milestone-anniversary size for a mantel; Large and XL are showpieces for the entryway or grand-room display. For 50th and 60th anniversaries, the Large or XL is the customary scale.  Can I engrave our wedding date, vows excerpt, or anniversary year? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Common layout: portrait centered, names below, wedding date or vows excerpt at the bottom.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below - especially meaningful for evening dining-table display during anniversary dinners.  Can I restore an older wedding photo for engraving? Yes - our design team handles light restoration of older photos at no extra charge. For heavier restoration (torn photos, missing sections), contact us before ordering.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD is recommended for anniversary keepsakes - the finer point density preserves skin tones and fine text legibility, especially for older-photo restorations. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Her is a birthday, anniversary, Valentine's, or just-because gift that turns your favorite photo into a vertical block of K9 optical crystal she can keep on her vanity, nightstand, or desk for life. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building her photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the natural format for vertical portraits 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background Five sizes from Small to Max - pick by display surface and gift intent Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives finest gradient detail Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot   Perfect for every milestone in her year The Rectangle for Her lives at every milestone in her calendar - her birthday (a candid that captures who she is), your anniversary (the couple portrait or a wedding photo), Valentine's Day (a defining couple moment), just because (the candid from last summer's trip), and marking a major life chapter (a promotion, a graduation, a move, a milestone birthday). The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to two people; for full-family groups, choose the larger XL or Max size. For the heart silhouette, see the Heart for Her.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload her photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming her image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best The rectangle favors vertical portraits - a clear portrait of her solo, a candid from a shared moment, a defining family or couple photo. Clear, well-lit photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where her face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Small for a vanity, dresser, or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or living-room shelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or grand-room display.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and is especially nice for vanity or bedside display where evening lighting is dim.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates and short messages fit in the corners.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos.  How long does it last? Indefinitely. The engraving is permanent inside the K9 crystal - it does not fade, peel, or scratch off. See our guide on how long 3D crystals last. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building his photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to two people; for the heart silhouette, see the Heart for Him.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload his photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming his image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best The rectangle favors vertical portraits - a clear portrait of him solo, a candid from a shared adventure, a defining family or couple photo. Clear, well-lit photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where his face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Small for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or den shelf; XL and Max are showpieces for an office console or grand-room display. For an office desk, Small or Medium fits naturally without dominating the space.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and is especially nice for office or den display where evening lighting is dim.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - For Him-Standard / Mini
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Him is a birthday, anniversary, Father's Day, or just-because gift that turns your favorite photo into a vertical block of K9 optical crystal. The Beyond Memories® rectangle is the classic portrait orientation - his image sculpted in three dimensions and laser-engraved inside the glass so it can be seen from every angle. Substantial weight, razor-sharp edges, and the engraving suspended in three dimensions - a gift that suits his desk, bookshelf, or den.  Every Rectangle for Him starts with the photo you upload at checkout. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building his photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the gallery-style framing for vertical portraits 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background Five sizes from Small to Max - pick by display surface and gift intent Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives finest gradient detail Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot   Perfect for every milestone in his year The Rectangle for Him lives at every milestone in his calendar - his birthday (a candid that captures who he is), your anniversary (the couple portrait or wedding photo), Valentine's Day (a defining couple moment), Father's Day (a family portrait or candid with the kids), retirement (a photo from the role he's leaving), and just because (the candid from last weekend, gifted out of nowhere). The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to two people; for the heart silhouette, see the Heart for Him.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload his photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming his image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best The rectangle favors vertical portraits - a clear portrait of him solo, a candid from a shared adventure, a defining family or couple photo. Clear, well-lit photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where his face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts.  Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick? Small for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or den shelf; XL and Max are showpieces for an office console or grand-room display. For an office desk, Small or Medium fits naturally without dominating the space.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and is especially nice for office or den display where evening lighting is dim.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos.  Is the Rectangle for Him a good Father's Day gift? Yes - commonly ordered for Father's Day with a family portrait or photo with the kids. See the Rectangle for Dad variant if specifically targeting Dad-themed framing. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Him is a birthday, anniversary, Father's Day, or just-because gift that turns your favorite photo into a vertical block of K9 optical crystal. The Beyond Memories® rectangle is the classic portrait orientation - his image sculpted in three dimensions and laser-engraved inside the glass so it can be seen from every angle. Substantial weight, razor-sharp edges, and the engraving suspended in three dimensions - a gift that suits his desk, bookshelf, or den.  Every Rectangle for Him starts with the photo you upload at checkout. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building his photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms.   100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the gallery-style framing for vertical portraits 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background Five sizes from Small to Max - pick by display surface and gift intent Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives finest gradient detail Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot   Perfect for every milestone in his year The Rectangle for Him lives at every milestone in his calendar - his birthday (a candid that captures who he is), your anniversary (the couple portrait or wedding photo), Valentine's Day (a defining couple moment), Father's Day (a family portrait or candid with the kids), retirement (a photo from the role he's leaving), and just because (the candid from last weekend, gifted out of nowhere). The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to two people; for the heart silhouette, see the Heart for Him.  How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload his photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming his image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base.  What photo works best The rectangle favors vertical portraits - a clear portrait of him solo, a candid from a shared adventure, a defining family or couple photo. Clear, well-lit photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where his face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced.  What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable.  Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet.  Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts.  Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick? Small for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or den shelf; XL and Max are showpieces for an office console or grand-room display. For an office desk, Small or Medium fits naturally without dominating the space.  Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and is especially nice for office or den display where evening lighting is dim.  Can I add a name, date, or short message? Yes - add it in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners.  Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is excellent for most photos. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Pet Lovers from Beyond Memories® turns your favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a heart-shaped keepsake engraved inside solid optical crystal. Whether your pet is still curled up next to you on the couch or has crossed the rainbow bridge, this is the way their face stays with you in light - on the mantel, the bookshelf, the bedside table, exactly where they used to sleep.  Your photo is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and laser-engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a 4K subsurface laser. The portrait lives inside the glass - it cannot fade, cannot peel, cannot be damaged by sun or water. Real artists at our Las Vegas studio prepare every photo and oversee every engraving. No algorithms, no auto-generated portraits.      K9 optical crystal - lead-free, optically pure, hand-polished to museum finish    True 3D subsurface engraving - your pet sculpted in three dimensions inside the crystal    4K HD available - recommended for pets where fur detail and eye reflection matter most    Five sizes - Mini through XL for any space    Free photo enhancement - we clean up the background, balance lighting, and color-correct before engraving (no extra cost)    Memory Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving from below in eight colors    Premium gift-ready box - satin lined, ready for gifting or for sympathy gifts    U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - based in Las Vegas, real humans you can reach   Perfect for celebrating - or honoring - your pet  For the dogs and cats still with you, this is the keepsake you put on the mantel because you can't stand the thought of forgetting how they look today. For the pets who have crossed the rainbow bridge, it is the most-requested sympathy gift we ship: a portrait of the dog or cat suspended inside light, often paired with the collar or a paw print impression on a shelf, so the family can return to that corner of the home and remember. Pet lovers gift this crystal at the end of a long life, the day after a difficult goodbye, on the anniversary of a loss, on a birthday, or simply because they wanted to mark this season of being a person who lives with a beloved animal.  How the personalization works  Choose your size based on where the crystal will live (Mini fits on a desk, Large anchors a mantel). Upload one favorite photo of your pet - or you with your pet - through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, sharpens the fur detail, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then sculpt the portrait in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the K9 crystal. Standard turnaround is 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout for time-sensitive memorial orders.  What photo of your pet works best  For pets, the heart shape is most powerful with a single subject framed close. A clean shot with the pet's face well-lit, ears up or in a typical relaxed position, eyes catching light - this is the engraving recipe. Side profiles work for dogs with distinctive snouts (greyhounds, collies). Full-face portraits work for cats and brachycephalic breeds (pugs, bulldogs). Photos where the fur is in focus and the eye reflection is visible engrave beautifully. Avoid extreme motion blur, heavy filters, and photos where the pet is in deep shadow. If you have a few options, send us 2-3 after ordering and our team will recommend the strongest engraving candidate.  What's in the box  Every Heart for Pet Lovers ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The presentation matters - many of these orders are bought as sympathy gifts and the receiving family is opening the box during the hardest week of their year. Our box was designed for that moment: simple, dignified, and ready to display.  Crystal care  K9 optical crystal is heirloom-durable. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight on a bookshelf, mantel, or bedside table. Dust gently once a month with the included microfiber cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Keep away from extreme heat or harsh chemicals. The engraved portrait is inside the glass, so it will not fade or scratch even if the outer surface gathers dust over the years.  Production and shipping  Standard production takes 1-2 business days. Express production is available at checkout for 1-2 business days, which we strongly recommend for memorial orders being given at a service or a specific date. We ship from our Las Vegas studio with full tracking via UPS/FedEx. Domestic U.S. shipping is included on most orders. International shipping calculated at checkout for most countries. For breeds with intricate coat patterns (Australian Shepherds, merle Aussies, calico cats), the 4K HD upgrade is highly recommended.  Can I engrave a photo of my pet from when they were a puppy or kitten? Yes. Many customers send us a portrait collage of the pet across their life. We can also engrave a single age-specific photo at any life stage.  What about a photo of my pet that's a little out of focus or older? Send it anyway. Our photo team can often restore older or slightly blurry images. If we cannot get the photo to engraving quality, we will reach out before production starts.  Is this an appropriate sympathy gift for a friend who just lost their dog? Yes - we ship these as sympathy gifts every single day. The crystal arrives in dignified gift packaging, ready to display, and feels respectful without being heavy.  Can I include my pet's name or the dates engraved alongside the portrait? The crystal itself displays only the 3D portrait. Many customers add a small engraved brass plate to the base separately, or write the pet's name and dates on the back of the gift box's care card insert.  Will the engraving outlive me? Yes. K9 optical crystal is the same glass used in scientific instruments and will look exactly the same in 50 years as it does on day one. The engraving is inside the glass - it cannot fade. 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Heart - Pet Lovers-Standard / Mini
description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Pet Lovers from Beyond Memories® turns your favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a heart-shaped keepsake engraved inside solid optical crystal. Whether your pet is still curled up next to you on the couch or has crossed the rainbow bridge, this is the way their face stays with you in light - on the mantel, the bookshelf, the bedside table, exactly where they used to sleep.  Your photo is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and laser-engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a 4K subsurface laser. The portrait lives inside the glass - it cannot fade, cannot peel, cannot be damaged by sun or water. Real artists at our Las Vegas studio prepare every photo and oversee every engraving. No algorithms, no auto-generated portraits.      K9 optical crystal - lead-free, optically pure, hand-polished to museum finish    True 3D subsurface engraving - your pet sculpted in three dimensions inside the crystal    4K HD available - recommended for pets where fur detail and eye reflection matter most    Five sizes - Mini through XL for any space    Free photo enhancement - we clean up the background, balance lighting, and color-correct before engraving (no extra cost)    Memory Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving from below in eight colors    Premium gift-ready box - satin lined, ready for gifting or for sympathy gifts    U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - based in Las Vegas, real humans you can reach   Perfect for celebrating - or honoring - your pet  For the dogs and cats still with you, this is the keepsake you put on the mantel because you can't stand the thought of forgetting how they look today. For the pets who have crossed the rainbow bridge, it is the most-requested sympathy gift we ship: a portrait of the dog or cat suspended inside light, often paired with the collar or a paw print impression on a shelf, so the family can return to that corner of the home and remember. Pet lovers gift this crystal at the end of a long life, the day after a difficult goodbye, on the anniversary of a loss, on a birthday, or simply because they wanted to mark this season of being a person who lives with a beloved animal.  How the personalization works  Choose your size based on where the crystal will live (Mini fits on a desk, Large anchors a mantel). Upload one favorite photo of your pet - or you with your pet - through our simple uploader. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, sharpens the fur detail, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then sculpt the portrait in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the K9 crystal. Standard turnaround is 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout for time-sensitive memorial orders.  What photo of your pet works best  For pets, the heart shape is most powerful with a single subject framed close. A clean shot with the pet's face well-lit, ears up or in a typical relaxed position, eyes catching light - this is the engraving recipe. Side profiles work for dogs with distinctive snouts (greyhounds, collies). Full-face portraits work for cats and brachycephalic breeds (pugs, bulldogs). Photos where the fur is in focus and the eye reflection is visible engrave beautifully. Avoid extreme motion blur, heavy filters, and photos where the pet is in deep shadow. If you have a few options, send us 2-3 after ordering and our team will recommend the strongest engraving candidate.  What's in the box  Every Heart for Pet Lovers ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The presentation matters - many of these orders are bought as sympathy gifts and the receiving family is opening the box during the hardest week of their year. Our box was designed for that moment: simple, dignified, and ready to display.  Crystal care  K9 optical crystal is heirloom-durable. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight on a bookshelf, mantel, or bedside table. Dust gently once a month with the included microfiber cloth. Mother's Day is the obvious one, and we ship thousands of these in the weeks leading up to the second Sunday of May. A grandparent-with-grandchild shot works wonderfully - the more emotional connection visible on the faces, the more powerful the crystal. Avoid extreme close-ups where only a partial face is visible, photos with heavy filters or beauty smoothing that have erased detail, and group shots with more than 4 people (faces will be small inside the heart shape). For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a tiny amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). If you use a Memory Light Base, simply lift the crystal off and wipe both pieces separately. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Mom from Beyond Memories® turns your favorite photo of Mom into a heart-shaped sculpture of optical glass that catches the light in every room she walks into. Whether you're shopping for Mother's Day, her birthday, a milestone anniversary, or simply a Sunday surprise, this is the keepsake she will keep on her bedside table or windowsill for the rest of her life - because every time the sun hits it, she sees the face that matters most. Your photo of Mom (or you with Mom, or your kids with their grandmother) is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a precision 4K subsurface laser. The result is unmistakable: a portrait suspended inside clear glass, depth you can feel from every angle, and details that no flat print can replicate. The work is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms.   K9 optical crystal - the same lead-free glass used in laboratory optics, hand-polished to a flawless finish  True 3D subsurface engraving - your photo is sculpted in three dimensions and laser-etched inside the crystal, not printed on the surface  4K HD upgrade - available on every size for the highest level of facial detail  Five sizes - Mini, Small, Medium, Large, and XL to match her space  Free photo enhancement - our in-house artists clean up your photo before engraving (no extra cost)  Beyond Memories Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving from below in eight LED colors  Premium gift-ready box - ships in a satin-lined presentation box ready to hand to Mom  U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - Las Vegas based, real humans on the phone  Perfect for Mom, every occasion The Heart for Mom keepsake fits a lifetime of moments - not just one. Mother's Day is the obvious one, and we ship thousands of these in the weeks leading up to the second Sunday of May. But Mom's birthday lands beautifully here too: pair the crystal with her favorite cake and a handwritten card and you will see her face change the moment she sees her grandchildren engraved in glass. For milestone moments - her 50th, her 60th, your wedding day, the day she became a grandmother - a heart-shaped crystal feels like an heirloom from the moment it leaves your hands. And for the quietest occasions - a Christmas she didn't expect, a Sunday lunch, the day after her chemo ended - it is the gift that says "I see you" without needing words. Mothers who have lost their own mothers tell us this gift takes on another layer entirely. How the personalization works Pick the size that fits her space (Mini sits on a bedside table, Large anchors a mantel, XL becomes a centerpiece). Upload one favorite photo of Mom - or you with Mom, or her grandkids - through our simple uploader. Our in-house photo team gently cleans up the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then convert the photo into a true three-dimensional model and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to sculpt the portrait inside the K9 optical crystal. The engraving is permanent, will never fade, will never peel, and lives inside the glass - not on top of it. The full process from upload to ship typically takes 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout if you need it sooner. What photo works best The heart shape is gentle on portraits and looks best with a single subject or two subjects framed close. A clear, well-lit headshot of Mom against any simple background works beautifully (we will remove the background for you). A photo of you with Mom, foreheads almost touching, makes for an unforgettable engraving. A grandparent-with-grandchild shot works wonderfully - the more emotional connection visible on the faces, the more powerful the crystal. Avoid extreme close-ups where only a partial face is visible, photos with heavy filters or beauty smoothing that have erased detail, and group shots with more than 4 people (faces will be small inside the heart shape). When in doubt, send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend which one will engrave best. What's in the box Every Heart for Mom ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The box is designed for direct gifting - she opens the box and the crystal is the first thing she sees, cradled in soft satin against a dark linen lining. If you order with our Memory Light Base (sold separately), the base ships in its own protective sleeve and slots cleanly into the same gift box for a unified presentation. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is incredibly durable but rewards a little kindness. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight in a high-traffic spot like a mantel, bookshelf, or bedside table. Dust gently once a month with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a tiny amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). If you use a Memory Light Base, simply lift the crystal off and wipe both pieces separately. Keep away from extreme heat or chemical contact and your crystal will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days after your order. Express shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination, with rates calculated at checkout. Frequently asked questions Will Mom see her own face clearly inside the crystal? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraving captures facial detail with photographic clarity. She will recognize the photo instantly - and so will anyone else who sees the crystal. Can I send a photo where Mom is wearing glasses or a hat? Absolutely. Hats, glasses, jewelry, scarves - whatever makes Mom look like Mom is exactly what we want to capture. What if the photo is older and a little blurry? Send it anyway. Our photo team can often restore older images. If we cannot get the photo to engraving quality, we will reach out before production starts to discuss options. Do I need to buy the Light Base? No - the crystal looks beautiful on its own. The Light Base (sold separately) adds eight LED colors that illuminate the engraving from below, making the portrait glow in low light. Most customers add it when buying for a parent or grandparent. What if Mom doesn't love it? We have a 30-day satisfaction promise. If the engraving doesn't capture the moment the way you imagined, we will rework it at no cost or refund the order. Is this a good gift for a mom who has lost her own mother? Yes - many of our most cherished orders are heart crystals engraved with a photo of the grandmother who is no longer here. The K9 glass tradition of preserving a portrait inside light is, for many families, exactly the comfort needed. description: The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Mom from Beyond Memories® turns your favorite photo of Mom into a heart-shaped sculpture of optical glass that catches the light in every room she walks into. Whether you're shopping for Mother's Day, her birthday, a milestone anniversary, or simply a Sunday surprise, this is the keepsake she will keep on her bedside table or windowsill for the rest of her life - because every time the sun hits it, she sees the face that matters most. Your photo of Mom (or you with Mom, or your kids with their grandmother) is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a precision 4K subsurface laser. The result is unmistakable: a portrait suspended inside clear glass, depth you can feel from every angle, and details that no flat print can replicate. The work is done by real artists at our Las Vegas studio - not algorithms.   K9 optical crystal - the same lead-free glass used in laboratory optics, hand-polished to a flawless finish  True 3D subsurface engraving - your photo is sculpted in three dimensions and laser-etched inside the crystal, not printed on the surface  4K HD upgrade - available on every size for the highest level of facial detail  Five sizes - Mini, Small, Medium, Large, and XL to match her space  Free photo enhancement - our in-house artists clean up your photo before engraving (no extra cost)  Beyond Memories Light Base compatible - sold separately, illuminates the engraving from below in eight LED colors  Premium gift-ready box - ships in a satin-lined presentation box ready to hand to Mom  U.S. studio + U.S. customer support - Las Vegas based, real humans on the phone  Perfect for Mom, every occasion The Heart for Mom keepsake fits a lifetime of moments - not just one. Mother's Day is the obvious one, and we ship thousands of these in the weeks leading up to the second Sunday of May. But Mom's birthday lands beautifully here too: pair the crystal with her favorite cake and a handwritten card and you will see her face change the moment she sees her grandchildren engraved in glass. For milestone moments - her 50th, her 60th, your wedding day, the day she became a grandmother - a heart-shaped crystal feels like an heirloom from the moment it leaves your hands. And for the quietest occasions - a Christmas she didn't expect, a Sunday lunch, the day after her chemo ended - it is the gift that says "I see you" without needing words. Mothers who have lost their own mothers tell us this gift takes on another layer entirely. How the personalization works Pick the size that fits her space (Mini sits on a bedside table, Large anchors a mantel, XL becomes a centerpiece). Upload one favorite photo of Mom - or you with Mom, or her grandkids - through our simple uploader. Our in-house photo team gently cleans up the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We then convert the photo into a true three-dimensional model and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to sculpt the portrait inside the K9 optical crystal. The engraving is permanent, will never fade, will never peel, and lives inside the glass - not on top of it. The full process from upload to ship typically takes 1-2 business days. Rush production is available at checkout if you need it sooner. What photo works best The heart shape is gentle on portraits and looks best with a single subject or two subjects framed close. A clear, well-lit headshot of Mom against any simple background works beautifully (we will remove the background for you). A photo of you with Mom, foreheads almost touching, makes for an unforgettable engraving. A grandparent-with-grandchild shot works wonderfully - the more emotional connection visible on the faces, the more powerful the crystal. Avoid extreme close-ups where only a partial face is visible, photos with heavy filters or beauty smoothing that have erased detail, and group shots with more than 4 people (faces will be small inside the heart shape). When in doubt, send us 2-3 options after you order and our team will recommend which one will engrave best. What's in the box Every Heart for Mom ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The box is designed for direct gifting - she opens the box and the crystal is the first thing she sees, cradled in soft satin against a dark linen lining. If you order with our Memory Light Base (sold separately), the base ships in its own protective sleeve and slots cleanly into the same gift box for a unified presentation. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is incredibly durable but rewards a little kindness. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight in a high-traffic spot like a mantel, bookshelf, or bedside table. Dust gently once a month with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a tiny amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). If you use a Memory Light Base, simply lift the crystal off and wipe both pieces separately. Keep away from extreme heat or chemical contact and your crystal will look exactly the same in 30 years as it does today. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days after your order. Express shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination, with rates calculated at checkout. Frequently asked questions Will Mom see her own face clearly inside the crystal? Yes. The 4K HD subsurface laser engraving captures facial detail with photographic clarity. She will recognize the photo instantly - and so will anyone else who sees the crystal. Can I send a photo where Mom is wearing glasses or a hat? Absolutely. Hats, glasses, jewelry, scarves - whatever makes Mom look like Mom is exactly what we want to capture. What if the photo is older and a little blurry? Send it anyway. Our photo team can often restore older images. If we cannot get the photo to engraving quality, we will reach out before production starts to discuss options. Do I need to buy the Light Base? No - the crystal looks beautiful on its own. The Light Base (sold separately) adds eight LED colors that illuminate the engraving from below, making the portrait glow in low light. Most customers add it when buying for a parent or grandparent. What if Mom doesn't love it? We have a 30-day satisfaction promise. If the engraving doesn't capture the moment the way you imagined, we will rework it at no cost or refund the order. Is this a good gift for a mom who has lost her own mother? Yes - many of our most cherished orders are heart crystals engraved with a photo of the grandmother who is no longer here. The K9 glass tradition of preserving a portrait inside light is, for many families, exactly the comfort needed. We then convert the image into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet. Can I combine a home photo, address, and closing date in one engraving? Yes. Upload the home photo and describe the text layout you want (e.g., "Address line at bottom, closing date at right corner") in Special Instructions. Most realtors send the Medium or Large - substantial enough to feel like a premium gift, not so large it dominates the client's mantel.
